ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The main structure in the figure is an amide/carbonyl chain from left to right; on the left, R1 is connected to a carbonyl carbon, this carbonyl carbon is double-bonded to O and single-bonded to an N bearing H; N is then connected to the adjacent carbon, and R2 is attached to this carbon; this carbon continues to connect to the carbonyl carbon on the right, and the carbonyl carbon on the right is double-bonded to O and single-bonded to R3. The curved arrows in the figure are ignored according to the question. Reasoning: Write this skeleton as R1-C(=O)-N(H)-C(R2)-C(=O)-R3. Represent R1, R2, and R3 all with the wildcard *, and write from the left carbonyl to the right carbonyl according to the heavy-atom connection order: *C(=O)N, then the carbon bearing R2, C(*), and then connect to the right carbonyl bearing R3, C(*)=O. Therefore the SMILES is *C(=O)NC(*)C(*)=O.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a chain R1-C(=O)-N(H)-C(R2)-C(=O)-R3, disregarding all curved arrows. Replace each R group by '*' and write the heavy-atom connectivity from the left carbonyl to the right carbonyl: *C(=O)N for R1-carbonyl-amide N, then C(*) for the carbon bearing R2, then C(*)=O for the carbonyl bearing R3. The resulting SMILES is *C(=O)NC(*)C(*)=O.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中主体结构是一条从左到右的酰胺/羰基链，左侧有 R1 连接到一个羰基碳，该羰基碳双键连接 O，并单键连接到带 H 的 N；N 再连接到相邻碳，该碳上连有 R2；该碳继续连接到右侧羰基碳，右侧羰基碳双键连接 O，并单键连接 R3。图中的弯箭头按题意忽略。推理：将该骨架写作 R1-C(=O)-N(H)-C(R2)-C(=O)-R3。把 R1、R2、R3 都用通配符 * 表示，并从左侧羰基到右侧羰基按重原子连接顺序书写：*C(=O)N，然后是带 R2 的碳 C(*)，再接右侧带 R3 的羰基 C(*)=O。因此 SMILES 为 *C(=O)NC(*)C(*)=O。

planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction only to know that the requested output is the SMILES expression and that the arrows in the transition-state drawing must be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: represent generic R groups as wildcard atoms '*', carbonyls as C(=O), omit the explicit N-H hydrogen unless needed, and encode substituents on a carbon with branches such as C(*).
